dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Slims Creek area (NTS 84F/SW) (GIS data, line features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the line features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 581, Surficial Geology of the Slims Creek Area (NTS 84F/SW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Slims Creek Area (NTS 84F/SW) (GIS data, line features)
